finding.problem: The pause menu primary resume label is white on a pale hover background and is difficult to read.
finding.expected: Primary action text should remain legible when the pointer hovers over the button.
observed: The fresh normal844-pause screenshot shows the「続ける」button with white text on pale green.
Current CSS sets primary text to white. Its global button:hover rule sets the hovered background to#e7eee5.
The primary class background rule does not override the more-specific button:hover rule.
unknown: Other primary buttons have not been independently hovered in a browser by this reviewer.
